name: Image upscaler (resampling)
Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
description: Resample 2×, 3× or 4× with a quality filter and an unsharp pass. Classic resampling that enlarges what is there rather than inventing detail.

seo.metaTitle: Image upscaler (resampling) — free in your browser, no upload | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Upscale an image 2×–4× with high-quality resampling and unsharp masking, entirely in your browser tab. No neural model, no upload, no account.
seo.aeoSummary: This upscaler resamples your image 2×–4× with an unsharp mask inside your browser tab. It is deterministic resampling, not a neural upscaler, and your image is never uploaded.

faqs.question: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No model is involved. The tool resamples your pixels with a quality filter and an unsharp pass; nothing is uploaded and no weights are downloaded.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate AI image upscaler & restorer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/image_upscaler.json or open /tools/image-upscaler?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Select or drop your image into the browser workspace.
Configure processing parameters and preview the updated image in real time.
Download your final processed image directly to your device with 0 server uploads.

desc: Resamples to 2×, 3× or 4× with a high-quality filter plus an adjustable unsharp pass. This is classic resampling — it enlarges what is already there and does not invent detail — and the page says so rather than implying a generative model.
